comments.body:
Progress + honest residual (session 2026-07-03).

LANDED ON MAIN (Gerrit 256):
- Phase 1 baseline dual-write SHADOW — new baseline_shadow.py; when reconciler.baseline_dual_write=true, every persisting pass advances a per-binding baseline from curr WITHOUT any consumer reading it, logging baseline_shadow_check {equal,divergent,seeded} vs prev_snapshot and baseline_shadow_divergence on M>0. Wired into reconcile._persist_and_log before save(); flag off by default; fail-open. Tests: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_baseline_shadow.py.
- Rollback procedure + the workflow_dispatch mode brake + circuit breaker + dual-write shadow documented in docs/jira-sync-setup.md (## Convergence rollout & rollback).
- Circuit breaker (check_blast_radius, default 0.10) is already ENFORCED before the first acting mutation for the level-triggered walk's decisions (terminal-transition / retire / adopt) — landed with 249/253; refuses a mass-retire/mass-transition/mass-adopt pass.

REMAINING CODE (safe to do, not yet done):
- Phase 3 consumer swap: re-point outbound_fields._local_matches_prev from prev_snapshot to BindingStore.get_baseline behind a flag, preserving absent-baseline->local-wins + corrupt-store fail-closed + direction arbitration byte-for-byte, with the RED direction-preservation property test against the swapped consumer. Deliberately NOT flipped: the epic's own risk plan requires >=10 clean shadow passes first.
- decision_census emitted every pass in EVERY mode (report + acting) + classifier-vs-legacy divergence alerting in shadow (Phase 2 breadth beyond the walk's per-pass census).

REMAINING OPERATIONAL (CANNOT run in an agent session — needs live production Jira + the deployed 20-min workflow):
- >=10 consecutive clean live shadow passes (baseline_shadow_check divergent==0), ~3.5h wall clock, before flipping the Phase-3 consumer.
- Capped live heal under bootstrap-strict of the 7 known drift instances (REB-464/456/465/466/457 terminal, f8b5->REB-530 GC, REB-532 adopt); assert next-pass census = 0 acting.

This ticket stays in_progress: the detection + heals for classes A/B/C/D are live on main and their tickets are closed+signed, and the safe rollout derisk (dual-write shadow + rollback controls) is landed, but the consumer-swap flip and the live-pass validation are the operational tail owned by the deployed reconcile-bridge workflow.

## Summary
Execute the SAFE ROLLOUT of epic 3006-e198 after the foundation (amiss-bun-wince / baf7) and the four drift-class heals land: baseline dual-write shadow, shadow consumer with divergence alerting, the prev_snapshot->baseline consumer swap, live circuit-breaker wiring, and the capped live heal of the 7 known drift instances. Approved remediations 1+2 from the 2026-07-03 derisk evaluation live here. Deployment context: .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml runs `rebar reconcile --mode live` every 20 min from main; its workflow_dispatch `mode` input is the ROLLBACK BRAKE (pin to dry-run) at every step below.

## Phase 1 — baseline dual-write shadow (approved remediation 2)
- In the live pass (reconcile.py, after the existing baseline-advance at pass end), when config `reconciler.baseline_dual_write=true`: call `BindingStore.set_baseline` for every bound key from the pass's curr snapshot, WITHOUT changing any consumer (outbound_fields still reads prev_snapshot).
- Each pass logs `SyncLogger.log("baseline_shadow_check", equal=N, divergent=M, keys=[...])` comparing the stored baseline vs the prev_snapshot values for the 5 mirrored fields; any M>0 raises a bridge_alert.
- GATE: >= 10 consecutive clean passes (M==0) recorded before Phase 3. Passes are ~20 min apart, so this is ~3.5 hours of wall clock minimum.

## Phase 2 — shadow consumer + divergence alert (approved remediation 1 wiring)
- Every pass, in EVERY mode, emit the foundation's decision_census record (counts, acting_pct, breaker verdict) via sync_logger.
- Run the classifier in REPORT mode against the same pass artifacts and log any divergence between its acting set and the acting mutations the legacy path planned; divergence -> bridge_alert. (This is the level-triggered path auditing the edge-triggered path before it replaces it.)

## Phase 3 — consumer swap (the ONE high-risk seam; do this last and alone)
- Re-point `outbound_fields._local_matches_prev` (and its caller in outbound_differ) from prev_snapshot values to `BindingStore.get_baseline`; PRESERVE: absent-baseline -> local-wins degrade; corrupt-store fail-closed pass abort; direction arbitration semantics byte-for-byte (ADR 0026 #1-#3).
- prev_snapshot is NOT deleted in this ticket: L3 single-pass suppression still computes outbound+inbound against the same snapshot (ADR 0029 #3). Removing prev_snapshot entirely is a follow-up only after N clean passes.
- RED-first test: the direction-preservation property must run against the SWAPPED consumer (a Jira-side edit with local==baseline is mirrored inbound, never reverted).

## Phase 4 — live heal under caps
- Wire check_blast_radius into the apply path: a pass whose acting decisions exceed `reconciler.max_acting_fraction` (default 0.10) aborts with a bridge_alert BEFORE any mutation.
- workflow_dispatch the reconciler at mode=bootstrap-strict (MODE_CAPS=10) to heal the 7 known instances (5x archived->Done, 1x GC REB-530 after grace, 1x adopt REB-532); verify the NEXT pass's census reports 0 acting decisions (fixed point reached on live data); then return to live.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Dual-write shadow behind `reconciler.baseline_dual_write` with per-pass baseline_shadow_check logging + alert on divergence; >= 10 consecutive clean live passes recorded (cite pass ids in a closing comment).
- [ ] decision_census emitted every pass in every mode; classifier-vs-legacy divergence logged + alerting in shadow.
- [ ] Consumer swap merged with the direction-preservation property test running against the swapped consumer; corrupt-baseline fail-closed abort preserved; prev_snapshot retained for L3.
- [ ] Circuit breaker enforced in the apply path (abort BEFORE first mutation, alert emitted); config default 0.10.
- [ ] The 7 known drift instances healed under bootstrap-strict caps; next-pass census = 0 acting decisions; evidence (census log excerpts) attached to this ticket.
- [ ] Rollback procedure (pin workflow mode input to dry-run) documented in docs/jira-sync-setup.md.
